ai-schema.pageDescription: Paste any URL — we fetch the page, classify content type, and AI emits valid JSON-LD schema markup grounded in the actual on-page content. Won't invent fields that aren't there (Google penalises for that).
ai-schema.noSuggestions: The page doesn't fit any rich-result schema type. AI returned no suggestions.
ai-schema.pasteHelp: Paste this inside a tag in your '<'head'>'. Always validate in Google's Rich Results Test before shipping.

auto-link.pageDescription: Paste content + your site's internal page list. AI proposes contextual internal links — exact anchor text + target URL — that you can apply manually or push via the WP bridge.
auto-link.pagesLabel: Your internal pages — URL TAB title (one per line)
auto-link.noSuggestions: AI didn't find any link opportunities. Try expanding the page list or relaxing the content.
auto-link.suggestionsTitle: {count, plural, one {# link suggestion} other {# link suggestions}}

browser-agent.pageDescription: Goal-driven headless Chrome. Give it a starting URL + a plain-English goal — it reads the page, decides the next step, executes, and narrates each move with a screenshot. Replaces 'I need an API for that site' with browser automation.
browser-agent.errGoal: The goal must be 10 to 500 characters long.
browser-agent.errMaxSteps: Max steps must be between 1 and 25.
browser-agent.goalPlaceholder: Find the pricing page and extract every plan name + monthly price
browser-agent.help: The agent runs entirely in your local headless Chrome via the browser pool — no third-party automation API. Each step is logged with a screenshot for review.
browser-agent.stoppedAfter: Stopped after {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}

bulk-alt.pageDescription: Paste any URL — we crawl every '<'img'>', AI generates SEO-friendly alt text for each based on nearby context. Replaces RankMath's bulk image SEO. Copy the output to your CMS or run via the WP bridge.
bulk-alt.suggestionsTitle: {count, plural, one {# alt-text suggestion} other {# alt-text suggestions}}

content-helpers.pageTitle: Content helpers — cover-image prompts + category / tag suggester
content-helpers.pageDescription: Two AI helpers for every post you publish. Cover-image prompts in 3 distinct styles you can paste straight into Stable Diffusion / Midjourney / DALL-E. Category and tag suggestions tailored to your existing taxonomy.
content-helpers.coverHelp: Paste these into Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, DALL-E, or any image model. 3 distinct visual styles per call.
content-helpers.coverTitlePlaceholder: The 9 best vegan meal-prep services in 2026
content-helpers.briefPlaceholder: What the post is about in one or two sentences
content-helpers.categoriesHelp: Avoids tag-soup and category bloat. AI picks one primary category and 5-10 SEO-worthy tags. Paste your existing categories so it reuses, doesn't reinvent.
content-helpers.categoryTitlePlaceholder: How to set up Cloudflare full-page caching for WordPress
content-helpers.existingLabel: Existing site categories (one per line or comma-separated, optional)

content-score.errAiNoResponse: AI provider didn't respond. Set up an API key in Settings.
content-score.title: Content scorer
content-score.description: Paste a draft (or live page text) + your target keyword. AI scores it on readability, density, structure, and E-E-A-T signals — then surfaces specific changes + LSI terms to add.
content-score.contentPlaceholder: Paste the draft here. Plain text or HTML — we strip tags.
content-score.termsHelp: Semantically-related terms top-ranking pages include for this keyword. Add naturally — don't stuff.

disavow.pageDescription: Paste your backlink list (URLs or domains, optionally TAB-anchor). We auto-flag toxic ones (spam TLDs, casino / payday / random-string domains, suspicious anchors) and emit a Google-spec disavow file.
disavow.errNoBacklinks: Paste at least one backlink (URL or domain per line).
disavow.backlinksLabel: Backlinks — URL or domain per line, optional TAB+anchor

desc.mozDomainAnalysis: Get the Domain Authority (DA) score, top linking domains, spam score, and the keywords this domain ranks for.
desc.ahrefsBacklinkChecker: See the top 100 backlinks pointing at this domain, their Domain Rating, and the anchor text used.
desc.openLinkProfiler: Free real-time backlink index — daily-refreshed list of every link they could find pointing at this domain.
desc.ubersuggestDomainOverview: Estimated organic traffic, top pages, top keywords, and a 'SEO Difficulty' for the domain. Free 3 lookups/day.
desc.semrushDomainOverview: Authority score, organic traffic estimate, keyword count, top organic competitors. Free with signup.
desc.googleKeywordPlanner: Real Google search volumes, suggested CPC, and seasonal trends. Free with any Google Ads account.
desc.googleTrends: Search interest over time + regional breakdown + related queries. Best for spotting rising / falling demand.
desc.answerThePublic: Auto-completes turned into question / preposition / comparison clusters — content brief gold.
desc.alsoAsked: Maps People-Also-Ask cluster trees — see how Google groups related questions. Free 3/day.
desc.keyworddit: Pulls keywords mined from Reddit threads — language real humans actually use, not what AI tools predict.
desc.pageSpeedInsights: Real-world Core Web Vitals (LCP / INP / CLS) from CrUX + lab Lighthouse audit + concrete fix suggestions.
desc.gtmetrix: Waterfall + opportunity report. Free 3 tests/day, no signup. Useful second opinion vs PSI.
desc.webPageTest: Multi-location detailed performance run — slowest network types, video filmstrip, deep waterfall. Free.
desc.mobileFriendlyTest: Pass / fail + screenshot of how Google renders this URL on a phone. Catches mobile-only issues.
desc.richResultsTest: Validates JSON-LD + previews which rich result types this URL is eligible for (FAQ, Recipe, Product, etc.).
desc.schemaValidator: Strictly validates JSON-LD against the schema.org spec — catches type errors Rich Results Test ignores.
desc.mozillaObservatory: Grades security headers A+ to F with concrete checklist (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.).
desc.ssllabs: Detailed TLS / SSL grade A+ to F. Slow (~2 min) but the gold standard for cert + cipher analysis.
desc.securityHeaders: Quick HTTP-header grade by Scott Helme. Faster than Observatory; good for daily checks.
desc.searchConsole: Indexing status, manual actions, sitemaps, performance — Google's own truth source. Free, requires verification.
desc.bingWebmaster: Bing's GSC equivalent + a free SEO audit. Underused — easy free wins for audit reports.
desc.bingSiteSearch: Quickest indexed-pages estimate. We auto-do this in /tools/domain-overview but it's worth eyeballing.
desc.googleSiteSearch: Google's indexed-pages eyeball. Less reliable than GSC's coverage report but instant.
desc.waybackMachine: How long this domain has been live, what it looked like before, and whether prior owners spammed it.
desc.icannWhois: Domain registration date, registrar, owner if not WHOIS-private. Reveals domain age.
desc.perplexity: Citation-first AI search. Test which of your tracked queries cite your domain in answers.
desc.chatgpt: Manually test whether ChatGPT cites your site for tracked queries. Search-mode required.
desc.googleAio: Plain Google search — note when AIO appears + which sources it cites. Cross-check our SERP scanner.

external.title: External tools launchpad
external.intro: Paste a URL or keyword once. Every tool below opens with your context pre-filled — no retyping. Use this for the metrics we can't compute ourselves (real DA, full backlink index, SSL grade, search volume).
external.emptyHint: Enter a URL or keyword above — each tool below will open with that input pre-filled where the tool supports it.

gsc-coverage.pageDescription: Paste up to 60 URLs from the same property. We hit Google's URL Inspection API for each, summarise indexing state, surface the ones that aren't indexed and why. Free — uses your GSC OAuth quota.
gsc-coverage.setupTitle: Connect Google Search Console to use this
gsc-coverage.setupDetail: Index coverage is Search Console data by definition — it is Google telling you what it did and did not index.
gsc-coverage.errAiNoResponse: AI didn't respond. Check Settings → AI provider, or retry — the global semaphore may have queued behind a daily-agent task.
gsc-coverage.errAiInvalidJson: AI response wasn't valid JSON. Try again.
gsc-coverage.allIndexed: ✓ Everything you pasted is indexed cleanly. No fixes needed.
gsc-coverage.fixPlanHelp: Per-URL diagnosis + concrete steps. Auto-apply hooks are surfaced where the WP bridge could do the change for you — wire up Settings → WordPress per client to enable them.

link-intersect.pageDescription: Sites that link to your competitors and not to you — the list link building actually starts from. Each page is read once and checked against every domain at the same time, so whether a site already links to you comes from its own HTML, not from a search that might have missed it.
link-intersect.errNoCompetitor: Add at least one competitor domain.
link-intersect.yourDomainHint: Checked on every page we read, so a link you already have is never pitched back to you.
link-intersect.competitorsLegend: Competitor domains — two or three beats one
link-intersect.competitorsHelp: A site that has linked to two of your competitors has shown the pattern rather than made a one-off decision, so those rank first. With a single competitor there is no pattern to find.
link-intersect.statsChecked: checked against {domain} and {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}}. Page-level evidence. A site can link to you from a page these searches never surfaced, so “already links to you” means on a page we actually read.
link-intersect.gapsTitle: Link to a competitor, not to you
link-intersect.gapsSubtitle: Sorted by how many of your competitors each one links to. Start at the top.
link-intersect.gapsEmpty: Nothing came back as a gap. Either the searches found no pages linking to these competitors, or every page that did also links to you.
link-intersect.alreadySubtitle: Here so you don't pitch them again. Worth checking the anchor text and whether the link is still dofollow.

migration-map.pageDescription: Paste old URL list + new URL list. We map every old URL to its closest new URL using token overlap + path-segment similarity. Outputs an Nginx / Apache / Next.js redirect block ready to ship. Saves a 50-page migration from a multi-day spreadsheet job.
migration-map.errNoHighConfidence: No high-confidence matches to import. Review the table first.
migration-map.imported: ✓ Imported {count} high-confidence rules into the redirect manager.

robots.issueBlocksAll: robots.txt blocks the entire site (Disallow: /). Search engines can't crawl anything.
robots.findBlocksAllDetails: A bare 'Disallow: /' with no Allow rule tells every crawler to read nothing. Pages already indexed drop out over the following weeks, and new ones are never seen.
robots.issueNoSitemapDirective: No Sitemap directive declared in robots.txt. Add one to help discovery.
robots.findNoSitemapDirectiveTitle: robots.txt does not point at a sitemap
robots.findNoSitemapDirectiveDetails: robots.txt is the one place every crawler looks for a sitemap. Without the line, discovery falls back to following links, which is slower and misses orphan pages.
robots.issueMissing: No robots.txt found. Create one — even an empty allow-all is better than nothing.
robots.findMissingDetails: Not fatal — crawlers assume they may read everything — but it is the only place to name a sitemap or set a policy for AI crawlers, and its absence usually means nobody has decided either.
robots.findUnreachableDetails: The request returned {status}. A crawler that cannot read robots.txt may treat the whole site as disallowed, so this is worse than having no robots.txt at all.
robots.issueNoSitemapFound: No sitemap files found at any declared or default location.
robots.findNoSitemapFoundTitle: No sitemap at any declared or default location
robots.findNoSitemapFoundDetails: Neither robots.txt nor /sitemap.xml produced a readable sitemap. Google will still crawl what it can reach by following links, but nothing tells it what exists.
robots.findSitemapBrokenDetails: The URL is declared but did not return valid sitemap XML.
robots.title: Robots.txt + sitemap validator
robots.description: Fetch + parse robots.txt and every sitemap it declares. Surface common indexability foot-guns.
robots.noIssues: No issues. robots.txt + sitemaps look healthy.

screenshot-import.pageDescription: Drag a screenshot from Ahrefs, Semrush, GSC, GA4, or any internal dashboard. AI vision extracts the structured data so you can copy it into the tool and stop paying for tools you only use occasionally.
screenshot-import.errImageType: Image must be PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP.
screenshot-import.errNoVision: No vision-capable AI provider responded. Configure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter in Settings.

metric_panel.label: Metric / KPI panel
metric_panel.hint: Traffic, conversions, MRR — with current/previous values

search-volume.pageDescription: Free directional volume estimate. Combines Google Trends interest, Google + Bing autocomplete signals, and SERP characteristics. Doesn't give exact monthly numbers (no paid API can without buying clickstream data) but gives a 5-bucket relative volume per keyword — accurate enough to prioritise.
search-volume.keywordsPlaceholder:
vegan cookbooks
best meal planner
budget recipes for beginners
search-volume.estimatesHelp: Bucket = relative monthly volume. Confidence reflects how many of the four signal sources we got data from.

security.findMissingTitle: {count, plural, one {# security header missing} other {# security headers missing}}
security.findMissingDetails: Missing: {headers}. These are set once on the server or CDN and cost nothing to serve.
security.findWeakTlsDetails: Protocol {protocol}, issued by {issuer}. A weak grade usually means an outdated protocol or cipher suite still enabled.
security.findCertExpiringTitle: SSL certificate expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
security.findCertDetails: An expired certificate makes every browser refuse the site outright. Valid to {validTo}.
security.title: Security headers + SSL
security.description: Mozilla Observatory + SSL Labs + critical HTTP headers in one shot. All free APIs. SSL Labs may take up to 60s if uncached.
security.observatoryUnreachable: Couldn't reach Observatory. Try again in a moment.
security.sslNotCached: SSL Labs result not cached yet. Run again in 30-60s after starting an analysis on <link>ssllabs.com</link>.
security.headersHelp: Direct check of the response headers. Even when one of the external APIs fails, this is reliable.

headerHints.strict-transport-security: Forces HTTPS for future visits. Should include max-age and includeSubDomains.
headerHints.content-security-policy: Prevents XSS by allow-listing script sources.
headerHints.referrer-policy: Controls how much of the URL is sent on link-clicks.
headerHints.permissions-policy: Restricts browser feature access (camera, mic, etc).

social-preview.pageDescription: See exactly how your URL will look when pasted into X / LinkedIn / Slack / Facebook / iMessage. Catches missing og:image, relative URLs, missing twitter:card — the things that quietly halve your social CTR.

soft-404.pageDescription: Crawl a site, flag pages that return 200 but smell like 404s — thin content ('<'100 visible words), '404'/'page not found' text patterns, generic error titles. Google labels these soft-404 in GSC and won't index them; most teams never check.

findingLabels.thin-content: Pages with almost no content returning 200
findingLabels.404-text-pattern: Pages that say 'not found' but return 200
findingLabels.404-title-pattern: Pages titled like an error but returning 200
findingLabels.no-h1-thin: Thin pages with no heading returning 200

soft-404.findingDetails: Google treats a 200 as "this page exists", so these get indexed and compete with real pages. Affected: {urls}
soft-404.noCandidates: ✓ No soft-404 candidates on the first {count} pages.
soft-404.fixOrder: Fix order: 410 if intentionally deleted, 301 if there's a better page, expand content otherwise.

wp-hack-scan.pageDescription: Probes a live WordPress site from the outside for active compromise indicators: backdoor files, exposed configs, JS injection, hidden iframes, spam injection, cloaking, version disclosure. Returns a containment + cleanup + prevention playbook.
wp-hack-scan.help: Remote-only scan via HTTP probes — we can't read PHP files on your server. For deep file inspection install Wordfence or Sucuri on the WordPress side. This catches what's visible externally (which is usually how Google notices first).
wp-hack-scan.quickFixTitle: ⚡ Quick fix: enable Cloudflare "Under Attack Mode"
wp-hack-scan.quickFixBody: If you have Cloudflare on this domain, turn on Under Attack Mode (Security → Settings) right now — it interposes a JS challenge that blocks most automated exploit traffic while you clean up.

youtube-audit.pageDescription: Paste any public YouTube video URL. We pull title / description / tags / captions / thumbnail / engagement, run a 14-point checklist (title length, keyword placement, description depth, chapters, hashtags, tags, captions, thumbnail resolution, like ratio, freshness), and AI writes step-by-step fix instructions for each failing item. Free — uses oEmbed + watch-page scrape (or your YouTube Data API key for richer data).
